propositions: The packaged code-review guide at src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md lines 112–114 contains stale instructions telling contributors to ping a maintainer when a coverage-gap `-1` block occurs.

Contributor-triggerable re-review via the `recheck-review` comment on a change has been implemented and deployed to production (Gerrit change 1243), but the packaged guide was not updated to reflect this self-service capability.
The stale documentation actively misdirects contributors by omitting the self-service `recheck-review` option and continues to recommend the outdated manual workaround of pinging maintainers.
The coverage-gap bullet must be updated to name `recheck-review` as the primary self-service re-trigger and clarify that coverage-gap blocks are infrastructure vetoes, not diff issues.
The updated guide text must align with existing documentation in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/review-policy.md that describe the parallel between `recheck` (CI) and `recheck-review` (LLM review).
